narrow_fix_receipts.fixed_statement: For free nearest-neighbor adjacency on Z^3, every spectral measure is absolutely continuous. For periodic odd-L boxes and any fixed nondegenerate energy interval I with closure inside (-6,6), the number M_L of box eigenvalues in I tends to infinity and at least M_L/2 adjacent gaps among the sorted levels in I are zero. Hence infinite-volume a.c. alone does not imply GOE bulk local statistics. This is a lambda=0 auxiliary counterexample only.
narrow_fix_receipts.reproduction: Fourier transform gives multiplication by h(theta)=2 sum cos(theta_j). Its gradient is nonzero off eight Haar-null points, so null energy sets have null preimage and all weighted spectral measures are a.c. For odd L, k->-k has only fixed point k=0 at energy 6 outside I; all I-momenta pair, giving at most M_L/2 distinct energies and at least M_L/2 zero gaps. A nondegenerate I has open positive-measure preimage; boundary energy levels have Haar-null preimage, so M_L/L^3 approaches a positive measure. Strictly monotone unfolding preserves zero gaps.
